correctness.rationale: For finite clique bouquets K_1∨(disjoint K_{r_i}) with unit masses and conductances and 1<p<∞, the active edge derivative is bounded by μ_p=max_i[N-r_i-2-(r_i-1)c_p] times L_G^(p-1). For a hub–blade edge, each other-blade vertex contributes at most +1; direct edge -2, blade common vertices at most -c_p by the sharp scalar minimum of t^(p-1)+(1-t)^(p-1). Internal blade edge gap has no positive other-blade contribution. The explicitly configured hub=1, active blade vertex=0, other vertices 0 or 1/2 and outsiders 2 attains μ_p; dissipativity and maximum principle yield global flow, time-continuity and necessity/sufficiency. Since μ decreases with r_i, all m-blade cases reduce to r_min; thresholds m=1 always, m>=4 never, m=3 only three size-1 blades, m=2 iff b<=2+(a-1)c_p. Homogeneity gives unbounded normalized *instantaneous* rate for p≠2 when μ>0, not fixed-time amplification.
